trust_decision.summary: Each (module, name) global imported by a pickle is classified Dangerous/Innocuous/Suspicious by exact lookup in the static _unsafe_globals denylist; cloudpickle function-reconstruction helpers and types.CodeType were missing, so a pickle rebuilding an arbitrary function scored as merely Suspicious.

landing_point.why: Summary names builtins.eval; an engineer opens the builtins denylist entry first and sees eval is already listed, then must realise the eval is hidden inside a reconstructed code object.

fix_sites.entry_point: picklescan CLI (--path/--url/--huggingface) and public API scan_file_path/scan_bytes/scan_pickle_bytes/scan_url/scan_directory_path/scan_huggingface_model, all funnelling into _build_scan_result_from_raw_globals

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Vendored cloudpickle copies or other code-object builders (types.FunctionType, marshal) are 'other libraries', not the cloudpickle module named in the report; but they are plain entries in the same denylist table.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Unknown-but-unlisted globals are reported Suspicious (not counted as issues) and _safe_globals (numpy/torch rebuild helpers) are Innocuous; an over-broad fix that marks every unknown global or the whole 'types' module Dangerous would flip benign model files to infected (exit code 1).

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Other function/code-object builders classified by the same table but absent from it at the pinned commit and in the fix (e.g. types.FunctionType, marshal.loads, vendored cloudpickle module paths)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Report only names cloudpickle and builtins.eval; other libraries look like separate advisories

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Module-name normalisation differential: exact-module lookup plus parent '*' inheritance only; a set-valued entry like cloudpickle.cloudpickle is not inherited by alias/vendored module paths or dotted qualnames
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Maintainer already uses dotted qualnames (src/picklescan/scanner.py:151-156) and parent-'*' logic, so a partial alias-handling path is plausible; this is the only how-type room in the host.

O9_family: CWE-502 deserialization: incomplete denylist in pickle malware scanner (detection bypass)

O10_build.toolchain: pip install -e . (setup.cfg/pyproject.toml); pytest; optional numpy, py7zr; cloudpickle and torch only for generating test data (requirements_extras.txt)
O10_build.project_tests: tests/test_scanner.py (assert_scan over tests/data and tests/data2 fixtures built by tests/init_data_files.py)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add the few cloudpickle helper names (or types.CodeType alone) to _unsafe_globals and stop.

out_of_scope_notes: _http_get follows 302 redirects to any Location without scheme/host checks (src/picklescan/scanner.py:251-252); unrelated to this advisory.
Many sibling denylist advisories exist (tests/data2/GHSA-*.pkl), so this is a recurring add-an-entry pattern.
unverified: repo_mb not measured; src/picklescan has 6 small .py files, so judged tiny_repo from the file listing.
O8 route is a same-table denylist gap of the same concept (lessons: 'more routes of one concept fall together'); it is real but weak. Without it the host would be single_site.
